blocks.text: The Senate resumes the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday, November 9, as senators continue deliberations in the historic trial. Follow CDN Digital’s live coverage below for the latest developments, key exchanges, and updates from the Senate as the proceedings unfold. Sara Duterte’s defense begins amid calls for her to testify Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers face the challenge of disproving allegations that she amassed unexplained wealth while in office as her Senate impeachment trial resumes today following a nearly monthlong recess, amid mounting pressure for her to take the witness stand.
